stem_book: Consider the following order according to indicated property. (i) B–F bond length : BF₃ < BF₂OH (ii) Dipole moment : CHCl₃ < CH₃Cl (iii) Acidic strength : SO₃ < SeO₃ (iv) Number of d-orbitals participating in hybridisation : BrF₅ < PF₅. Find the total number of correct orders.
work: (i) ✓ OH competes for back-bonding → longer B–F in BF₂OH; (ii) ✓ 1.04 < 1.87 D; (iii) ✗ SO₃ more acidic; (iv) ✗ BrF₅ sp³d² (2 d) > PF₅ sp³d (1 d) → 2
